name: Agent-pay Payment Wall
description: Charges callers through a connected agent-pay gateway before requests are forwarded.
details: Drops a Payment element on the target that charges every MCP tool call through agent-pay. Select the connected agent-pay gateway and one of its payment surfaces after dropping the template; agent-pay owns the price, the payment methods and settlement. Narrow the triggers to charge only some tools, or set A2A method filters for an A2A surface. Pair with a rate-limit element if you also need per-caller throttling.
author: system
